tokens.name: color-canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything (html, body; theme-color). The light field and glass sit on it.

tokens.name: color-ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on color-canvas (11.6:1) and glass (12.7:1); headings, body copy, diagram node text. Also the primary button's fill.

tokens.name: color-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on color-canvas (6.7:1) and glass (7.3:1): ledes, captions, metadata, dates, figcaptions.

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: Accent text on glass and color-canvas (7.5:1): the accent pane's title. Use sparingly, for one highlighted item in a set.

tokens.name: color-link
tokens.usage: Inline links on color-canvas (5.5:1) and glass (6.0:1), underlined with a 3-4px offset; résumé section headings and its header rule.

tokens.name: color-blue
tokens.usage: Diagram and chart accent for marks only: strokes, pulses, the accent bar (3.7:1 on color-canvas, 4.0:1 on glass). Never text: it misses 4.5:1.

tokens.name: color-blue-deep
tokens.usage: Accent text inside diagrams and charts, on glass (6.4:1) and color-canvas (5.9:1); the info status colour.

tokens.name: color-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: 1px rules between rows, strips and sections (.employer-strip, .career-row, .site-footer). Decorative, not a control border.

tokens.name: color-line-strong
tokens.usage: The stronger 1px rule under the résumé nav (.resume-nav). Decorative.

tokens.name: color-ring
tokens.usage: The light field's blurred rings and the accent pane's gradient start. Decorative; never text or a control edge.

tokens.name: color-secondary
tokens.usage: Second light-field hue (radial glow, ring two). Decorative.

tokens.name: color-wash
tokens.usage: Third light-field hue (the soft radial washes behind the glass). Decorative.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: The frosted panel fill (.glass-panel), always with backdrop blur-panel over the light field. Falls back to glass-solid.

tokens.name: glass-solid
tokens.usage: Solid panel fill when backdrop-filter is unsupported or the reader prefers reduced transparency.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: The colour of the glass panel's large, soft drop shadow (inside shadow-panel).

tokens.name: scrub-from
tokens.usage: Start colour of the manifesto word scrub: 3.1:1 on color-canvas and 3.3:1 on glass, enough only for text 24px and up. Animates to color-ink.

tokens.name: dg-edge
tokens.usage: Diagram edges and arrowheads (3.1:1 on color-canvas, 3.4:1 on glass).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Derived (global.css :focus-visible). The keyboard focus ring: 3px solid, 5px offset; 6.1:1 on color-canvas, 6.6:1 on glass.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Derived (::selection). Text-selection background.

tokens.name: on-selection
tokens.usage: Derived (::selection). Selected text, on selection (8.9:1).

tokens.name: ink-hover
tokens.usage: Derived (.btn-primary:hover). The primary button's fill under a pointer.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Derived (.chip, .hiw-points li, .hiw-stage ul). Dense list and chip text on glass (8.8:1) and color-canvas (8.0:1).

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Derived (.btn-primary). Text and icons on a color-ink fill (13.3:1) or any status fill.

tokens.name: glass-raised
tokens.usage: Derived (.project-tab[aria-pressed=true]). The selected item in a glass group: tabs, toggles, menu highlight.

tokens.name: glass-control
tokens.usage: Derived (.chip, .pane-default). Small controls and chips sitting on a glass panel.

tokens.name: glass-inset
tokens.usage: Derived (.plate, .project-figure, .notfound-figure). Inset wells and plates: a figure inside a panel, an employer plate.

tokens.name: glass-faint
tokens.usage: Derived (.identity-strip nav). The faintest glass: track behind a pill nav or segmented control.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: Derived (.plate, .pane, .project-figure). The 1px light-catching border on glass surfaces.

tokens.name: dg-node-accent
tokens.usage: Derived (.dg-node-accent-fill .dg-box). Accent-filled diagram node or chart mark carrying on-ink text (5.5:1).

tokens.name: dg-bar
tokens.usage: Derived (.dg-bar). Muted bar fill in timing charts: 2.7:1 on glass, below the 3:1 mark floor, so a bar always carries its value label.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Addition (components need a status set). Errors and destructive actions: text and icons on color-canvas (5.8:1), glass (6.4:1) and danger-soft (5.6:1); fill under on-ink (6.7:1). Always with an icon or word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Addition. Tinted ground behind danger text (standard alerts, error helper rows).

tokens.name: danger-hover
tokens.usage: Addition. A danger fill under a pointer (the destructive primary button).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Addition. Warnings: text and icons on color-canvas (5.1:1), glass (5.6:1) and warning-soft (5.2:1); fill under on-ink (5.9:1). Always with an icon or word.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Addition. Tinted ground behind warning text.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Addition. Success, a teal kept off the red-green axis so it never relies on hue against danger: text and icons on color-canvas (5.2:1), glass (5.7:1) and success-soft (5.1:1); fill under on-ink (6.0:1).

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Addition. Tinted ground behind success text.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Addition, an alias of color-blue-deep: neutral information. Text on color-canvas (5.9:1) and info-soft (5.7:1); fill under on-ink (6.8:1).

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Addition. Tinted ground behind info text.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Addition (the site has no modal). The dimming layer behind a dialog or drawer: color-ink at 32% with a 6px backdrop blur, so the glass surface reads first.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Addition (charts). Series 1 and the single-series default: the brand's color-blue (OKLCH L 0.59, C 0.13, h 260). Bars, lines, dots, area washes and donut segments; marks only, ≥3:1 on color-canvas (3.65:1) and glass (3.98:1); text stays in color-ink/color-muted. Slot 1 of a fixed four-slot order, never cycled. Palette checked with the dataviz validator on adjacent pairs against both surfaces: worst CVD ΔE 14.8, worst normal-vision ΔE 16.5.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Addition (charts). Series 2: color-link's indigo (h 276) stepped to the 0.10 chroma floor (L 0.43). Marks only, ≥3:1 on color-canvas (7.27:1) and glass (7.93:1); text stays in color-ink/color-muted. Beside chart-1: ΔE 16.5 normal, 15.9 under CVD; beside chart-3: 21.3 and 19.5.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Addition (charts). Series 3: color-secondary's cyan stepped into the chart band (L 0.62, C 0.10, h 218). Marks only, ≥3:1 on color-canvas (3.10:1) and glass (3.37:1); text stays in color-ink/color-muted. Only ΔE 9.1 from chart-1, so the fixed order always keeps chart-2 between them; forms where any two marks can meet (scatter, small multiples) stop at two series.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Addition (charts). Series 4: a periwinkle on color-link's indigo, pushed toward violet (L 0.51, C 0.15, h 280). Marks only, ≥3:1 on color-canvas (5.29:1) and glass (5.76:1); text stays in color-ink/color-muted. Beside chart-3: ΔE 17.5 normal, 14.8 under CVD. Four series is the cap: a fifth folds into Other, drawn in dg-edge.
